newsitem.title: UK: Dixons rises to peak amid squeeze.
newsitem.headline: Dixons rises to peak amid squeeze.

text.p: Shares in UK retailer Dixons Group Plc resumed its advance, climbing to a record on Thursday, amid a continued squeeze after a large instutitional purchase late Tuesday, dealers said.
By 0909 GMT, the shares were up 19p to 614-1/2.
The recent rally was ignited earlier this week after a large "agency cross" trade - where a broker matched a buy and sell order between two clients - occurred at 600p.
"There's shortage of stock in the market. That's what's driving the shares," said one dealer.
Another said investors appeared heartened that the market was able to shrug off Wednesday's move by the government to increase competition in electrical retailing.
Dixons shares have advanced 14.5 percent since the group posted stronger-than-expected results on July 9.
